data.name: Santa Holiday Puzzle
data.detailed_description:
Step into a magical winter world filled with festive lights, falling snow, and cozy Christmas charm in Santa Holiday Puzzle, a relaxing and colorful match-3 puzzle game for players of all ages. Join Santa on a joyful holiday journey through snowy villages, glowing workshops, icy lands, and cheerful Christmas-themed worlds as you solve beautifully designed puzzles and spread holiday magic across every level.

Santa Holiday Puzzle is built around classic match-3 gameplay that is easy to learn and satisfying to master. Swap and match colorful tiles, create powerful boosters, and trigger spectacular combo reactions to clear the board and complete fun objectives. Each level introduces new challenges and keeps the gameplay fresh while remaining calm and stress-free. There are no timers or pressure mechanics, allowing you to play at your own pace and simply enjoy the experience.

The game features a warm and cozy Christmas atmosphere with bright festive visuals, smooth animations, and relaxing holiday music that makes every session feel comforting. Whether you play for a few minutes or enjoy longer sessions, Santa Holiday Puzzle is designed to help you unwind and have fun in a peaceful winter setting.

With dozens of handcrafted levels, satisfying explosions, and cheerful holiday charm, Santa Holiday Puzzle is perfect for casual players, families, and anyone who loves colorful puzzle games. It runs smoothly on PC, supports full-screen and windowed modes, and can be played completely offline.

Relax, match the tiles, enjoy the festive world, and help Santa bring holiday cheer one puzzle at a time in Santa Holiday Puzzle.

Features – Santa Holiday Puzzle

  • Classic match-3 puzzle gameplay

  • Festive Santa & Christmas theme

  • Colorful winter environments

  • Fun boosters and power-ups

  • Satisfying combo effects

  • Easy to play, relaxing gameplay

  • Dozens of unique levels

  • Cozy holiday music and sounds

  • Family-friendly for all ages

  • Fully offline playable
